web/src/routes/settings/notification-channels.tsx, web/src/components/settings/

The heartbeat card isn't on the dashboard page. `HeartbeatCard` is rendered only in `notification-channels.tsx`. The dashboard route is `web/src/routes/index.tsx`, and it doesn't use that card. If you meant the dashboard, the route file is `web/src/routes/index.tsx`. The new card component would then probably go in `web/src/components/dashboard/`.
